title: 连锁门店
description: 基于合成门店、交易、商品、库存快照和客流，比较经营表现、商品结构与缺货，不包含真实门店信息。

tables.name: stores
tables.description: 六家合成门店及所属区域

tables.name: products
tables.description: 商品参考售价与成本，交易统计使用明细历史单价

tables.name: transactions
tables.description: 门店收银交易，仅completed计入销售

tables.name: transaction_items
tables.description: 收银交易明细，数量、单价和成本为交易时值

tables.name: inventory_snapshots
tables.description: 每日库存快照；缺失行代表没有观测，不能当作0

tables.name: footfall
tables.description: 门店日客流统计，不是去重会员数

relations.description: 分别将已完成交易数量与客流聚合到日期×门店后，再同时按日期与门店关联；不可把日客流重复累计到交易明细。
relations.preaggregation: 两侧先分别按全部关联键聚合，包含日期与对象维度，禁止重复累计事实金额。

metrics.name: 门店销售额
metrics.description: 按transaction_date汇总completed交易；关联交易明细前确保不会重复累计整单金额。

metrics.name: 门店毛利
metrics.description: completed交易的商品成交额减历史成本，不含租金、人工、营销等费用。

metrics.name: 门店客单价
metrics.description: completed交易的销售额除以交易数，必须在交易粒度计算；并非每位去重顾客消费。
metrics.denominator: 同口径已完成订单或交易去重数

metrics.name: 商品销量
metrics.description: completed交易的商品件数，不是明细行数。

metrics.name: 期末库存
metrics.description: 每门店每商品取截至指定日期最近一条快照，再汇总stock_on_hand；不能累加跨日期快照。须展示实际快照日期，缺失不视为零。
filters: 每店每商品截至时点最近非缺失快照

metrics.name: 缺货观测率
metrics.description: 已观测门店×商品×日期快照中库存为0的比例；缺失快照不作为零库存，不等价于营业时长缺货率。

metrics.name: 客流成交比
metrics.description: 按日期×门店分别聚合completed交易数与客流，再按完整公共维度关联；不是去重用户转化率，不能按交易明细计数。

examples.question: 比较2025年第四季度各门店销售额和客单价。
examples.title: 2025年第四季度门店经营对比
examples.sql: SELECT s.store_name,ROUND(SUM(t.transaction_total),2) AS sales,ROUND(SUM(t.transaction_total)/COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id),2) AS aov FROM transactions t JOIN stores s ON t.store_id=s.store_id WHERE t.status='completed' AND t.transaction_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.transaction_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC

examples.question: 2025年第四季度各门店库存快照中的缺货观测率是多少？
examples.title: 门店缺货观测率
examples.sql: SELECT s.store_name,COUNT(*) AS observed_snapshots,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stock_on_hand=0) AS zero_snapshots,ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stock_on_hand=0)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS stockout_pct FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN stores s ON i.store_id=s.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND i.snapshot_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY stockout_pct DESC,s.store_name

examples.question: 2025年第四季度各门店的客流成交比是多少？
examples.title: 门店客流成交比
examples.sql: WITH sales AS(SELECT transaction_date AS date,store_id,COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM transactions WHERE status='completed' AND transaction_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND transaction_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY transaction_date,store_id),visits AS(SELECT visit_date AS date,store_id,SUM(visitors) AS visitors FROM footfall WHERE visit_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND visit_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY visit_date,store_id) SELECT v.store_id,COALESCE(SUM(s.transactions),0) AS transactions,SUM(v.visitors) AS visitors,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.transactions),0)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(v.visitors),0),2) AS conversion_pct FROM visits v LEFT JOIN sales s ON v.store_id=s.store_id AND v.date=s.date GROUP BY v.store_id ORDER BY v.store_id

business_knowledge.title: 库存快照不是流量
business_knowledge.content: 库存为时点余额。期末库存应逐门店逐商品取截至日期最近一条快照，不累计多个日期；比较库存变化时使用两个时点。

business_knowledge.title: 缺失库存不是零库存
business_knowledge.content: 缺失快照只说明未观测到库存，不能自动填零。缺货观测率的分母为有效快照数，并披露缺失数据；该比例不是缺货营业时长。

business_knowledge.title: 门店比较保持同口径
business_knowledge.content: 比较不同门店或不同时段时，应保持日期范围、交易状态和营业范围一致。期间天数不同应说明或补充日均指标，不能仅凭总额断言效率差异。

business_knowledge.title: 客流不是去重顾客
business_knowledge.content: 客流表是访问计数，交易表是收银单。客流成交比属于运营参考指标，不等价于用户级转化率，也不能据此判断某个顾客是否购买。

preferences.title: 默认按区域比较
preferences.description: 未指定经营比较维度时按区域，明确门店或商品要求优先。

preferences.title: 突出表现较弱的门店
preferences.description: 经营对比优先突出较弱门店，同时说明比较口径，不替换明确Top要求。

preferences.title: 对比优先用柱状图
preferences.description: 分类对比默认柱状图，时间趋势或用户明确图表要求不受影响。

repair_experiences.title: 计算客单价时聚合嵌套
repair_experiences.content: SQL不支持在同一聚合层直接嵌套SUM与AVG。先按交易汇总明细金额，再按门店计算平均交易额；以CTE区分交易粒度与门店粒度。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE transaction_items(transaction_id INTEGER,quantity INTEGER,unit_price DOUBLE)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT AVG(SUM(quantity*unit_price)) FROM transaction_items GROUP BY transaction_id
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: WITH per_transaction AS(SELECT transaction_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) amount FROM transaction_items GROUP BY transaction_id) SELECT AVG(amount) FROM per_transaction

repair_experiences.title: 库存字段误用数量列
repair_experiences.content: 库存快照的库存余额字段为stock_on_hand，quantity是交易明细销量。修复字段时依据表结构，不能把销量替代库存。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshots(store_id INTEGER,product_id INTEGER,snapshot_date DATE,stock_on_hand INTEGER)
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_on_hand) FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date=DATE '2025-12-31'

repair_experiences.title: 把每日库存累加为期末库存
repair_experiences.content: 库存快照按日期相加会重复累计同一批存货。按门店与商品分组，以截至日期最近快照为准再求和；缺失快照不要填零。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshots(store_id INTEGER,product_id INTEGER,snapshot_date DATE,stock_on_hand INTEGER)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_on_hand) FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date<=DATE '2025-12-31'
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: WITH latest AS(SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id,product_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) rn FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date<=DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT SUM(stock_on_hand) FROM latest WHERE rn=1

repair_experiences.title: 商品明细加权导致客单价偏差
repair_experiences.content: 将交易关联商品明细后直接AVG整单金额，会按明细数给交易加权。客单价应在一交易一行计算销售额除交易数；必要时先去重或汇总到交易粒度。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE transactions(transaction_id INTEGER,transaction_total DOUBLE,status VARCHAR)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT AVG(t.transaction_total) FROM transactions t JOIN transaction_items i ON t.transaction_id=i.transaction_id WHERE t.status='completed'
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(transaction_total)/COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) FROM transactions WHERE status='completed'

evaluation.question: 各区域有几家门店？
evaluation.sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) AS stores FROM stores GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年第四季度各门店销售额是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT store_id,ROUND(SUM(transaction_total),2) AS sales FROM transactions WHERE status='completed' AND transaction_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND transaction_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年各品类销量是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT p.category,SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM transaction_items i JOIN transactions t ON i.transaction_id=t.transaction_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE t.status='completed' AND t.transaction_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 截至2025年12月31日，各门店期末库存是多少？
evaluation.sql: WITH latest AS(SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id,product_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) rn FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date<=DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT store_id,SUM(stock_on_hand) AS stock FROM latest WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年第四季度门店2有多少条零库存快照？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_snapshots FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE store_id=2 AND stock_on_hand=0 AND snapshot_date>=DATE '2025-10-01'

evaluation.question: 2025年各门店客流分别是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT store_id,SUM(visitors) AS footfall FROM footfall WHERE visit_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年已完成交易的客单价是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(transaction_total)/COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id),2) AS aov FROM transactions WHERE status='completed' AND transaction_date>=DATE '2025-01-01'

evaluation.question: 共有多少种商品？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products

evaluation.question: 2025年有多少笔作废交易？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS void_transactions FROM transactions WHERE status='void' AND transaction_date>=DATE '2025-01-01'

evaluation.question: 2025年各区域毛利分别是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT s.region,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*(i.unit_price-i.unit_cost)),2) AS gross_profit FROM transactions t JOIN transaction_items i ON t.transaction_id=i.transaction_id JOIN stores s ON t.store_id=s.store_id WHERE t.status='completed' AND t.transaction_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

clarifications.question: 哪些门店效率差？
clarifications.answer: 比较2025年第四季度各门店日均销售额，并同时展示客单价与客流成交比。

clarifications.question: 库存还有多少？
clarifications.answer: 截至2025年12月31日，逐门店逐商品取最近库存快照，再按门店汇总。
